target_customer: Fast-growing startups that need studio-quality landing pages
problem: AI website builders make ugly pages easier while agencies have long waitlists and $100K minimums. Semiotic builds AI design agents that produce landing pages at studio quality.
business_model: Project-based or subscription design service delivered by AI agents (pricing not found)
product_category: AI design agents for landing pages

founders.name: Michael Roberson
education: Columbia, computer science and cognitive science (dropped out)
previous_startups: Design studio earning $30K a month (outcome not stated)

founders.name: Bryan Grisales
founders.background_notes: YC page: AI research at Columbia's Computational Design Lab.

competitors.name: PageAI
competitors.what: AI landing page builder that plans wireframes and writes copy and positions against Lovable and v0
competitors.traction_then: Launched June 12, 2025, 593 upvotes, #3 Product of the Day

competitors.name: AI Frame
competitors.what: Site builder and text generator inside Framer

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that generate high quality, editable React pages with visual editing and code export are demanding on design quality but built from existing models and front end tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI page builders launched in 2025 and design taste is hard to measure; the founders' brand design background is the stated differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: These tools already served AI page generation at the time of founding; no action aimed at Semiotic was found.

market_need_then: The YC page claims $78,000 in revenue in the first four weeks after launch (company stated, unverified). Agency costs and waitlists named in the description are the demand signal.

branding.domain_note: The YC listing points to semiotic.com, but the page fetched in this research showed a different product (Lighthouse elder monitoring), so the domain history is unclear.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: The YC description is blunt about rivals ('blue-purple gradient slop'); the fetched semiotic.com page was warm and family focused but belongs to a different product.

brand_strength.rationale: A word with a design meaning suits a design agent, and the company is led by a brand design person, but no press on the brand was found and other firms use the name (Semiotic AI, Semiotic Labs).

outcome_analysis: Semiotic is an active Fall 2025 company claiming $78,000 revenue in its first four weeks. No acquisition or shutdown news was found. Founders combine a brand design background with AI research at Columbia. The category was crowded by 2025 launches such as PageAI and Framer add-ons, so quality of output is the bet. Funding beyond the YC deal is not confirmed.
notes: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed in Nov 2025; a single aggregator figure matching the standard YC deal, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Other directories list Brandon Yao as a founder and one says the company was formerly called Mooodboard; neither appears on the YC page I opened, so they are not recorded. The semiotic.com page fetched showed Lighthouse, an elder-monitoring product, which conflicts with the YC description; treated as data and not used for the company's facts. Revenue claim is from the YC page only. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed in 2025-11 is recorded from VCBacked alone, matching the standard YC deal size. No press source found.
